dogecoin.text: Dogecoin Co-creator Jackson Palmer, in a now deleted tweet, said Tesla CEO Elon Musk "is and always will be self-absorbed grifter", according to multiple Twitter users who captured screenshots of his tweets. https://t.co/YujRXXT9Yw

Elon Musk responded to a Twitter user who said that the billionaire treats Dogecoin like one of his own companies and actively promotes DOGE. Musk responded, "Please note Dogecoin has no formal organisation and no one reports to me, so my ability to take action is limited." https://t.co/ymHvDqRSbZ
